senses.sense_definition: Characterized by a close and usually mutually beneficial relationship between two different entities or groups.

examples.text: The small company and the university developed a <w>symbiotic</w> relationship to share research facilities.
Local musicians and independent venue owners often share a <w>symbiotic</w> relationship that helps both survive.

senses.sense_definition: In biology, of or relating to the close and often long-term physical association between two different biological species.

examples.text: A lichen is formed by a fungus and <w>symbiotic</w> algae living together.
Certain types of bacteria establish a <w>symbiotic</w> association inside the roots of legumes.

senses.sense_definition: A symbiotic star, an interacting binary star system typically composed of a white dwarf and a red giant.

examples.text: Astronomers monitored the spectral emissions of the distant <w>symbiotic</w> over several months.
The newly cataloged variable is classified as a classic <w>symbiotic</w> with irregular eruptions.
